A simple stir‑fried chicken and veggies works well for a busy night. Slice 1 lb chicken breast thinly, toss with soy sauce, garlic, and ginger. Heat oil in a pan, cook chicken until browned, then add sliced bell pepper, broccoli florets, and snap peas. Stir‑fry 3–4 min, finish with a splash of sesame oil and a squeeze of lime. Serve over cooked rice or noodles.
